root_cause.text: The batman-adv OGM aggregation function does not verify that the destination skb has sufficient tailroom before appending a new packet, allowing a buffer overflow via skb_put when the aggregation state changes at runtime.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that an existing forwarded packet may have been allocated with only packet_len bytes, yet a later packet can still be selected for aggregation, leading to skb_put overflow. The patch adds a check `if (skb_tailroom(forw_packet->skb) < packet_len) return false;` in `batadv_iv_ogm_can_aggregate()` to reject aggregation when tailroom is insufficient.

intent_record.how: This prevents potential buffer overflow when appending the new packet to the skb for aggregation, ensuring safe memory operations.
